title: Sleep2Word: Peripheral-to-EEG Translation via Duration-Aware Wordization
abstract: arXiv:2611.21643v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Estimating full-night electroencephalography (EEG) spectrograms from peripheral measurements could extend EEG-informed sleep analysis to recordings acquired without EEG. This task requires compact representations of signals with different temporal structures. We introduce Sleep2Word, a framework for translating respiration, electrocardiography (ECG), or photoplethysmography (PPG) into EEG spectrograms through duration-aware physiological words. Building on context-dependent chunking, Sleep2Word groups physiological embeddings into variable-duration chunks and jointly quantizes their content and duration into modality-specific wordbooks. A block-autoregressive translator then predicts target EEG word identities and occurrence-specific duration refinements within fixed-duration blocks. This design accommodates independent source and target wordbooks, limits temporal drift, and shortens the autoregressive decoding path. Trained on over 20K

translated_title: Sleep2Word：通过时长感知的词化实现外周信号到脑电的翻译
translated_abstract: 从外周生理测量中估计整晚脑电图（EEG）频谱图，可以将基于脑电的睡眠分析扩展到在没有脑电设备情况下采集的记录。该任务需要对具有不同时间结构的信号进行紧凑表示。我们提出了Sleep2Word，一个通过时长感知的生理“词”将呼吸、心电图（ECG）或光电容积脉搏波（PPG）翻译为脑电频谱图的框架。基于上下文相关的分块机制，Sleep2Word将生理嵌入分组为可变时长的块，并将其内容与时长联合量化为模态特定的词本。随后，块自回归翻译器在固定时长的块内预测目标脑电词的身份以及针对特定出现情况的时长修正。这种设计支持独立的源词本与目标词本，限制了时间漂移，并缩短了自回归解码路径。该模型在超过2万（训练数据上进行了训练）
tldr: Sleep2Word提出了一种时长感知的词化框架，能够将呼吸、心电或脉搏波等外周生理信号翻译成整夜脑电频谱图，从而在没有脑电设备的情况下也能开展基于脑电的睡眠分析。
en_tdlr: Sleep2Word introduces a duration-aware wordization framework that translates peripheral signals (respiration, ECG, or PPG) into full-night EEG spectrograms, enabling EEG-informed sleep analysis without EEG recordings.
